name: string-escapes
description: The seven JCS shorthand escapes (\b \t \n \f \r \" \\) are emitted as shorthands. ASCII controls without shorthands (here U+0001) use \u00XX in lowercase hex. The slash character U+002F is NOT escaped per RFC 8785 section 3.2.2.2. U+007F (DEL) is NOT in the JCS escape set and passes through verbatim.
